title: Abandoned Rooftop → Dream Space
hook: Watch this abandoned rooftop come back to life
caption: Watch this abandoned rooftop come back to life 😍 Would you live here?
narration: This rooftop was completely abandoned. Trash everywhere, dirt, and broken things. Watch as the crew cleans it up, rebuilds it piece by piece, and brings it back to life. Now look at it. Would you spend your evenings here?
